description: This file contains utility functions for handling data masks, generating chart data payloads, and managing chart state in a Superset dashboard frontend. It includes functions for detecting filter changes and asynchronously building data payloads for stateful charts.

methods.name: getDataMaskChangeTrigger
methods.description: Detects changes in data masks, specifically for native filters and cross filters, comparing current and previous states.

methods.name: getChartDataPayloads
methods.description: Asynchronously generates data payloads for stateful charts in a dashboard, handling errors and optional chart ID filtering.
